tara: quick note - streaming examples diverge: Python shows resume_token + streaming loop but TS/Go still show single-shot create(). can we align before docs cut?
owen: good catch, paste snippets pls.
tara: python short: `resp = client.responses.create(model="rwd-4x", input=prompt, stream=True, resume_token=last_token)
for e in resp: if e.type=='delta': sys.stdout.write(e.delta)`
lee: i'll update TS to async iterator pattern and include `resumeToken` param.
maya: i'll update Go to include cursor pagination + simple backoff and honor `Retry-After`. add a one-liner about idempotency vs resume semantics.
docs-bot: checklist: 1) TS async iterator sample, 2) Go cursor+retry example, 3) one-line resume guidance per language, 4) mocked smoke tests under /examples/smoke/ for docs CI. label PRs with `ci: docs-smoke`.
owen: i'll open TS PR this afternoon.
lee: opened TS PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822
maya: opened Go PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823
docs-bot: PR 4822 merged, PR 4823 merged, smoke job passed. release note: "Unify streaming and pagination examples across SDKs; add resume/retry guidance."
tara: thanks team, closing thread - reopen if regressions.
